treatments.D0: Log-on event only (cause term, airborne at 00:19:37; no 00:19 measurement)
treatments.D9: Both timings + both frequencies as recorded
treatments.D10: Both timings + both frequencies, Holland start-up offset (17 Hz floor)
treatments.D14: Both timings + both frequencies, Holland start-up offset (zero floor)
treatments.D11: Both timings + 00:19:29 frequency as recorded + offset on 00:19:37 only, 17 Hz floor (Ashton premise with Holland's acknowledge bounds)
treatments.D12: Both timings + 00:19:29 frequency as recorded + offset on 00:19:37 only, zero floor (Ashton premise with Holland's acknowledge bounds)

use: Weights: w = exp(log_weight_<treatment>), normalise to sum 1. Every downstream module scores these same rows (composition rule 3).
caveats: Impact energy, attitude and angle of the no-pilot dives come from the case-informed kernel; dives above about Mach 0.99 have no recorded transport precedent.
Piloted rows keep the engine trajectories; their impact attitude is the engine's.
Break-up is not applied; settling applies it.
Energy-transfer duration is not computed (declared absence).

Flight-path angle: ground-relative, positive in descent, from the kinetic energies. Speed: ground speed. Track: ground track. Bank: kernel or engine value; normal-configuration glides use the Boeing donor bank.
Impact energy of no-pilot alternate-configuration dives is at or above the top of the Boeing range; treat the 4 GJ label as a sensitivity.
Only headline-treatment weights are carried; variants need the per-seed component files (out/*.npz).
